title: Preventing Pipe Sags and Slugging in Drain Lines
description: Maintaining proper slope in horizontal drainage piping is critical for solid waste transportation. Too little slope allows solids to settle and form blockages, while sagging pipes create low points, known as bellies, where standing water gathers grease and sediment. Regular structural maintenance involves inspecting pipe hangers and supports along suspended runs in basements or crawl spaces. Loose or missing hangers cause pipe deflections over time under heavy water loads. Securing pipes at proper code-compliant intervals prevents standing water, reduces recurring clogs, and preserves long-term drain self-cleansing velocity.

Preventing Pipe Sags and Slugging in Drain Lines

Maintaining proper slope in horizontal drainage piping is critical for solid waste transportation. Too little slope allows solids to settle and form blockages, while sagging pipes create low points, known as bellies, where standing water gathers grease and sediment. Regular structural maintenance involves inspecting pipe hangers and supports along suspended runs in basements or crawl spaces. Loose or missing hangers cause pipe deflections over time under heavy water loads. Securing pipes at proper code-compliant intervals prevents standing water, reduces recurring clogs, and preserves long-term drain self-cleansing velocity.
